partitions.nominal: A calibrated product plot exposes stable trace choices and generates a rereadable two-port Touchstone file.
partitions.boundary: A linear image axis accepts DC while logarithmic spacing rejects it, and a near-0 dB transmission uses exact-zero matched reflections without crossing the sampled passivity limit.
partitions.invalid: An uncalibrated trace candidate remains disabled for mapping until all required axes are supplied.
partitions.adversarial: A positive-loss-down axis is converted to negative S-parameter dB instead of mirroring the physical curve.
partitions.realistic: Ten hash-bound Samtec, JAE, Rosenberger, and Wilder product plots retain the human-reviewed physical trace counts; Wilder Figures 33 and 36 also retain each trace across at least 95% of the plot width.
partitions.known_failure: Unitless 0/5/0.1 is interpreted as GHz for the image form and preserves DC through Touchstone reread; a unique same-hue path split by steep notches recovers its missing prefix, while genuinely ambiguous same-hue multiple paths remain conservative; two unequal image grids still map, intersect without fill, interpolate, generate, and reread.
